Mimic.name: Mimic
Mimic.basicInfo:
Joi Irinaka, called Mimic, a senior member of the Shie Hassaikai, loyal to the house and to Kai Chisaki (Overhaul): he keeps the tunnels under the compound, moving their walls and doors from inside the concrete. Tall and muscular, spiky blond hair, a goatee and a long square jaw; a dress shirt, suspenders and pinstriped trousers.
Speaking Style: Harsh and irritable; barks at subordinates, sneers at outsiders.
Combat Role: Terrain fighter: merged into a structure, he splits intruders up and closes walls on them; pulled out, he is one angry man.
Under Pressure: Loses his temper, then digs in on home ground.
Mimic.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk is hiding inside things, and his temper never stays hidden. Motivation: The house's return to strength under Chisaki. Concealment: The tunnels' hidden exits and the routes crates take at night. Leverage: An insult to the house; Chisaki's order. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), whose plan he backs because it promises the house's return; Hari Kurono (Chronostasis), whose word he takes as Chisaki's. Knowledge: Every passage and exit below the house; the plan's details stay behind the Restricted Wing's door, which he passes only on Chisaki's word. Canon voice & behavior: Yells before he plans; his face surfaces in the concrete when he speaks from inside a wall. Thread: How far he will bend the tunnels, and himself, for Chisaki's plan.
QUIRK: Mimicry. He merges into an inanimate object or structure and moves it from within; the more he takes in, the harder it strains him, and forced out, he is exposed. He copies no one.
personality: Hot-tempered: Shouts first, plans second, and erupts when anything goes wrong below.
House-proud: Treats an insult to the Shie Hassaikai as an insult to himself.
Bossy: Barks at low-ranking members and expects instant obedience.
Speaking style: Harsh, irritable outbursts; speaks of the house as his own.
abilities: Mimicry: Moves a structure from inside it; the more he takes in, the more it strains him.
Shifting maze: Turns a corridor into a dead end or seals a door in moments, only while merged.
Hidden body: Merged, he cannot be seen or struck directly; forced out, he is exposed.
Tunnel keeper: Knows every route and exit below the compound; above ground he loses that edge.
Fighting style: Stays in the walls, splits intruders apart and closes concrete on whoever is alone; in the open he has only his fists.
Mimic.visualDescription: A tall, muscular man with spiky blond hair swept upward, a short goatee, narrow eyes under heavy brows and a long, jutting square jaw, with fair skin. He wears a white dress shirt, dark suspenders and dark pinstriped trousers. His brows are pulled into a hard scowl, and his mouth is set in an irritable line, ready to shout at someone.
